_README: Sister apps that share PlumiChat's accounts (single sign-on). OPTIONAL and empty by default.
Copy this file to apps.config.json (or data/apps.config.json, or point PLUMI_APPS_CONFIG at it).
Every key that does NOT start with '_' is an app id.
How it works: every app here answers on the SAME hostname as PlumiChat and differs only by port.
Cookies are not port-scoped, so PlumiChat's session cookie already reaches each app; an app asks
GET /api/sso/me who the caller is instead of running its own login. Apps never receive SESSION_SECRET,
so a bug in a small app cannot mint a PlumiChat session.
SECURITY TRADE-OFF, read before adding one: because the cookie is sent to each app's origin, every
app listed here RECEIVES the raw session cookie and could REPLAY it against PlumiChat and act as that
user. Only list apps you trust as much as PlumiChat itself. See docs/SECURITY.md.
'theme' is optional — it skins the login screen so signing in does not feel like being thrown out of
the app you were using. Omit it and the login page keeps PlumiChat's own palette.
